purpose: Joint scientific study with the Medical University of Vienna on the treatment of atrial fibrillation; results will be published openly.
question: How many patients with atrial fibrillation have an active oral anticoagulant, by region?
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Oral anticoagulant = ATC code starting with B01AA or B01AF.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with atrial fibrillation and how many of them have an active oral anticoagulant.
